svg.text: Axis truncated to 96–100% for legibility; bars are best observed cut / listed feasible reference.
Strongest value in two frozen public tables (Quicopt + OpenIsing, 2026-11-05); not a proved optimum. Exact matches: 5.
Winner selection is retrospective; equal-width segments represent all tied algorithms.
